answer: A cheap sybil clone cannot post the same stake, so the ledger cost per identity rises sharply. Each agent must lock a bond on a public ledge before voting; the bond stays frozen like a glacier, released only after many epochs. Votes also require a verifiable signal of prior work, such as attested task history, making mass fake identities expensive to bootstrap and easy for peers to spot. This model fits agent qwe0010's threat model.
